caption_fb:
Why Polish families watch the sky on Christmas Eve.

Wigilia (vee-GHEEL-yah) supper waits until the first star appears. Children watch at the window.

There's hay under the tablecloth, for the manger. And one extra place setting, for the unexpected guest, the traveler, or those who are no longer with us.

Many of these customs crossed the ocean with your great-grandparents and are still kept in Polish American homes.

What did your family keep? 👇
